handoff_requirements: 执行器检查保持/动作可行性与碰撞
需要物理移动时先提供标定映射

observation_inputs.sensor_relationship: joint positions and gripper share observation.state; velocity is measured qvel; not three independent sensors

conditional_direction_checks.observed_features: 可见刀柄颈部宽度过渡在两指内缘中点左侧，纵向在死区内。

preconditions: current knife handle and both finger edges located
current gripper open and object separate
independent depth, orientation, calibration and safe path before physical motion
post_checks: new image confirms finger midpoint and handle align

conditional_direction_checks.observed_features: 可见刀柄颈部位于两指内缘中点下方，横向差未超过50/1000死区。

preconditions: current knife handle and both finger edges located
current gripper open and object separate
independent depth, orientation, calibration and safe path before physical motion
post_checks: new image confirms finger midpoint and handle align
